primitives.note: Double Strike: basic attacks on-hit generate a stack (cap 3, 4s duration, refreshes on hit)
At 3 stacks the next basic attack is empowered to strike a second time for 50% AD physical on-hit damage, consuming the stacks
Alpha Strike vanishes Master Yi and makes him unable to act (~1s total) while it resolves
Alpha Strike places up to 4 marks (primary + up to 3 more, all on the sole dummy target since no other targets exist); primary detonates on reappear, later marks detonate instantly at 25% damage each

Each Alpha Strike detonation applies on-hit effects at reduced effectiveness (75% on primary, 18.75% on subsequent marks); Wuju Style adds bonus true damage on every basic attack on-hit for its duration
Alpha Strike's primary and lesser damage instances can critically strike using a custom BonusCritDamageRatio=1 modifier
On-hit basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's current cooldown by 1s, scaled by ability haste
Wuju Style: bonus true damage on-hit for 5s; Highlander: bonus attack speed (and movement speed) for 7s
Mana costs on Q (50-70), W (40), R (100) can constrain casts within the 15s window at low mana pools/levels
Meditate is a self-heal/damage-reduction channel that interrupts attacking; irrelevant against a non-attacking dummy and actively costs DPS uptime

needsBespoke.why: Master Yi's kit is expressible as a combination of listed primitives: a stacking on-hit passive that empowers an attack (P), a multi-part vanish-and-detonate active whose marks each apply on-hit at reduced effectiveness and can crit and refund its own cooldown (Q), a timed true-damage on-hit rider (E), and a timed attack-speed buff (R). No mechanic here (e.g. no pet, no stance/form swap, no ammo system) falls outside the closed list.

unsettled.question: Does Wuju Style's bonus true damage on-hit trigger on every one of Alpha Strike's mark detonations (up to 4 per cast, since each applies on-hit effects), or only once per Alpha Strike cast?

Only once per cast, since the wiki singles out only 'the first instance of damage' as counting for on-hit-triggered effects like Electrocute/Eclipse, implying later marks may not fully re-trigger all on-hit riders

Only the first instance of damage counts as a hit for effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}} and {{iis|Eclipse}}

options: Standard ability-haste CDR-multiplier formula (reduction scales down with haste)
A different/bespoke formula not visible in the sheet
No haste scaling at all in the fight if no haste items are used, making this moot for the base-kit sim

options: The wiki's stated ~1.087s total (4 bounces at 0.2s intervals + 0.15s exit delay, tick-adjusted)
A different effective duration if bounce timing behaves differently when repeatedly re-marking the same single target

proposal: At the start of the fight, cast R (Highlander) immediately to get its 7s bonus attack speed window running as early as possible (85s cooldown means only one use in the fight).
Immediately follow with E (Wuju Style) to arm basic attacks with bonus true damage on-hit for the next 5s.
Cast Q (Alpha Strike) as soon as both buffs are active so its marks land while Wuju Style and Highlander are up (each Alpha Strike hit also refreshes their current durations).

Between ability casts, basic-attack continuously: this builds Double Strike stacks toward the empowered second strike, applies Wuju Style's true damage on-hit, and reduces Alpha Strike's current cooldown by 1s per hit.
Recast Q (Alpha Strike) every time it comes off cooldown for the rest of the fight, since attacking accelerates its cooldown.
Recast E (Wuju Style) as soon as its 14s cooldown is up (around t=14s) to relight the true-damage on-hit window for the fight's final second.
Never cast W (Meditate): it interrupts autoattacking and its heal/damage-reduction have no value against a dummy that deals no damage.
questions: Should R (Highlander) be cast at t=0, or delayed slightly to align its 7s window with a burst of Q casts / on-hit procs for maximum overlap?

Does casting E or Q while auto-attacking interrupt the attack windup (does 'cast time = none' still consume a global action lockout that resets the attack timer), affecting how tightly they can be weaved between autoattacks?

With only one target available, does Alpha Strike still take the full multi-bounce travel time (0.2s per mark) when re-marking the same target, or does it resolve faster/slower than the wiki's assumed 4-distinct-target scenario?

Is there any in-game confirmation of whether Wuju Style's true damage rider applies on each of Alpha Strike's on-hit detonations against a single target, since this materially changes whether Q+E together are counted once or up to four times per Q cast?
